quarterly_data.quarter: NEC press release: NEC Presents Phase I/II Results for Individualized Oral (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Clinical (NEC Bio): Phase I/II results for NECVAX-NEO1, NEC Bio's AI-powered individualized oral bacteria-based DNA neoantigen therapy (IMMUNASIGHT neoantigen prediction + TORAPRIME oral delivery), in triple-negative breast cancer, presented at ESMO 2026 (e-poster, October 23, 2026): in the first cohort 8 patients received it on top of neoadjuvant chemotherapy and pembrolizumab; it was generally well tolerated, 5 patients achieved pathological complete response at surgery, and immunogenic neoepitopes were detected in all patients. NEC Bio Therapeutics CEO Heinz Lubenau: the trial is being extended to n=28 patients, including in the U.S. after a recently received IND approval, with cohort 2 on a higher dose on top of the Keynote-522 regimen.
quarterly_data.figure: 8 patients; 5 pathological complete responses; extension to n=28
